scripts.dev:e2e: pnpm e2e:prepare && mkdir -p artifacts/e2e/logs && concurrently --kill-others --names "site,api,worker" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,green" "bash -c 'set -o pipefail; pnpm --filter site dev 2>&1 | tee artifacts/e2e/logs/site.log'" "bash -c 'set -o pipefail; pnpm --filter api dev 2>&1 | tee artifacts/e2e/logs/api.log'" "bash -c 'set -o pipefail; OUTBOX_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=500 pnpm outbox:worker 2>&1 | tee artifacts/e2e/logs/worker.log'"
scripts.e2e:prepare: pnpm e2e:env && docker compose -f devops/docker-compose.yml down --volumes --remove-orphans && docker compose -f devops/docker-compose.yml up -d && tsx scripts/wait-for-e2e-services.ts && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm seed:e2e
scripts.dev:e2e:team-audit: corepack pnpm preflight:e2e:team-audit && corepack pnpm dev:e2e
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter api lint && corepack pnpm --filter site lint
scripts.test:partner-portal:api: NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules corepack pnpm --filter api exec jest --config jest.partner-portal.config.cjs --runInBand
scripts.test:partner-portal: corepack pnpm test:partner-portal:api && corepack pnpm test:partner-portal:site
scripts.typecheck:partner-portal: corepack pnpm --filter api typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter site typecheck && corepack pnpm typecheck:e2e:team-audit
scripts.quality:partner-portal: corepack pnpm typecheck:partner-portal && corepack pnpm test:partner-portal
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter api typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter site typecheck
scripts.db:migrate:media: corepack pnpm --filter api exec tsx scripts/migrate-to-target.ts 0058_appointment_media
scripts.db:migrate:media:check: corepack pnpm --filter api exec tsx scripts/migrate-to-target.ts 0058_appointment_media --dry-run
scripts.db:migrate:payments: corepack pnpm --filter api exec tsx scripts/migrate-to-target.ts 0059_square_payments
scripts.db:migrate:payments:check: corepack pnpm --filter api exec tsx scripts/migrate-to-target.ts 0059_square_payments --dry-run
scripts.payment-migration:audit: corepack pnpm --filter api exec tsx scripts/payment-migration-audit.ts
scripts.db:migrate:release-latest: corepack pnpm --filter api exec tsx scripts/migrate-to-target.ts latest
scripts.db:migrate:targets:validate: corepack pnpm --filter api exec tsx scripts/migrate-to-target.ts 0058_appointment_media --validate-files && corepack pnpm --filter api exec tsx scripts/migrate-to-target.ts 0059_square_payments --validate-files
